name: monorepo
shape: monorepo: backend, web apps, desktop app, CLI

platform.name: Unknown
platform.why: the deployment the repository maintains is self-hosting with docker compose (docker-compose.yml, prod.Dockerfile); netlify.toml and firebase.json are stale leftovers that publish packages/hoppscotch-web/dist, a package that no longer exists

processes.note: target backend (docker-compose.yml service hoppscotch-backend): packages/hoppscotch-backend/prod_run.mjs starts node dist/main with Caddy in front (backend.Caddyfile)
target app (docker-compose.yml service hoppscotch-app): Caddy serves the Vite build of packages/hoppscotch-selfhost-web from /site/selfhost-web
packages/hoppscotch-selfhost-web/webapp-server, started beside Caddy in the app target on :3200; serves signed web bundles to the desktop app
target sh_admin (docker-compose.yml service hoppscotch-sh-admin): Caddy serves the Vite build of packages/hoppscotch-sh-admin
service hoppscotch-migrate runs pnpm exec prisma migrate deploy; docker-compose.deploy.yml chains the same command before node aio_run.mjs

notes: Read docker-compose.yml (profiles), prod.Dockerfile (targets backend, app, sh_admin, aio), the prod_run.mjs entrypoints and the backend's NestJS modules; the separate-service profile is listed, the aio target runs the same four servers in one container under aio_run.mjs. The backend serves GraphQL subscriptions over websockets (subscriptions-transport-ws in app.module.ts) through an in-memory graphql-subscriptions PubSub (src/pubsub/pubsub.service.ts), so with more than one instance subscribers miss events published on another instance; graphql-redis-subscriptions is a dependency but unused, and no rule id covers this. The weekly @Cron in posthog.service.ts (@nestjs/schedule) is an in-process scheduler, and an admin config change calls stopApp() (src/infra-config/helper.ts) to SIGTERM the process and rely on the container restart, which on Cloud Run reloads only that one instance. docker-compose.deploy.yml chains prisma migrate deploy before the server, the release-migrations pattern, but in a compose file that rule does not read.

known.FALSE break: local-disk-write packages/h: a write behind a development-only flag (an env var or an argument that production never sets); the rule cannot read the flag (GENERATE_GQL_SCHEMA, run by a postinstall script)
